Field.name: fnVolume
Field.comment: The file names of tomograms

Field.name: fnModParticle
Field.comment: The file names of IMOD models for each tomogram.

Field.name: initMOTL
Field.comment: A code specifying how to construct the initial motive list: ^0: Set all rotational values to zero ^ ^1: Use the particle and reference model points to initialize ^ rotation around the tomogram z axis ^ ^2: Use the particle and reference model points to initialize ^ rotation around the tomogram x and z axes ^ ^3: Uniform random rotations ^ ^4: Random axial rotations ^ ^or a cell array of strings specifying the filenames to load
Field.tooltip: A code specifying how to construct the initial motive list or a cell array of strings specifying the filenames to load
Field.enum.0.tooltip: Set all rotational values to zero.
Field.enum.1.tooltip: Use the particle and reference model to align axes by rotation around the tomogram z axis only.
Field.enum.2.tooltip: Use the particle and reference model to align axes by rotation around tomogram x and z axes.
Field.enum.4.tooltip: Random axial rotations around the particle y axis

Field.name: flgFairReference
Field.comment: If 1, create a multiparticle reference. Otherwise, ^choose a single particle reference or use the user-specified volume.
Field.tooltip: Generate a multiparticle reference.

Field.name: flgNoReferenceRefinement
Field.comment: If 1, use the initial reference at all ^iterations. If 0 (the default), a refined estimate of the reference ^will be generated at each iteration.
Field.tooltip: Use the initial reference for template matching with no reference refinement.

Field.name: reference
Field.comment: = If flgFairReference = 1, an integer k specifying that a ^binary search using k levels will be used to generate a multiparticle ^reference containing 2^k particles. Otherwise, if a string, the name ^of an MRC file containing the reference volume, or if [i j], ^specifies the jth particle of the ith volume as the reference.

Field.name: maskType
Field.comment: Controls optional masking of the reference. ^If 'sphere' or 'cylinder", generate a spherical or cylindrical mask ^based on 'insideMaskRadius' and 'outsideMaskRadius'. The axis of the ^cylindrical mask will default to the particle Y axis, but can be ^overridden using MaskModelPts, below. If a string other than 'sphere', ^'cylinder', or 'none', the filename of an MRC image containing the ^mask, with non-zero values indicating voxels to be included. If ^missing, or set to 'none', there will be no masking.

Field.name: maskModelPts
Field.comment: Manually specify cylindrical mask orientation. ^If not empty, determines the axis of the cylindrical mask. The ^format is [Z Y], where Z and Y are Slicer angles specifying rotations ^in integer degrees around the tomogram Z and Y axes. These rotations ^(first Z, then Y) will be applied to an initial vector along the Y axis. ^If empty, PEET will attempt to choose an appropriate axis automatically.

Field.name: insideMaskRadius
Field.comment: Radius in pixels. ^Voxels at smaller radii will be masked out.

Field.name: outsideMaskRadius
Field.comment: Radius in pixels. ^Voxels at larger radii will be masked out.

Field.name: yaxisType
Field.comment: Specifies each particle's Y axis. ^0: use the volume's Y axis as the particle's Y axis. ^1: particle model points determine the particle Y axis. ^2: end points of the contour containing the particle determine the ^ particle Y axis. ^3: user-defined Y axes.
Field.enum.0.tooltip: Use volume's Y axis as the particle Y axis.
Field.enum.1.tooltip: Use vector between neighboring model points as the particle Y axis.
Field.enum.2.tooltip: Use end points of the contour containing the particle as the particle Y axis.
Field.enum.3.tooltip: Y axes will be read from <fnOutput>_Tom<n>_RotAxes.csv in the project directory or <volName>_RotAxes.csv in the volume directory.

Field.name: particlePerCPU
Field.comment: The maximum number of particles distributed ^simultaneously to a single cpu during parallel alignment processing.

Field.name: szVol
Field.comment: The size of the volume to be averaged in voxels.

Field.name: fnOutput
Field.comment: The base name to use in constructing output filenames.

Field.name: sampleSphere
Field.comment: If set to 'full' or 'half', speed up full- or half- ^spherical searches at the first iteration by automatically choosing ^appropriate angular sampling intervals for Theta and Psi based on ^sampleInterval. If missing or set to 'none', do a full grid search ^based on dPhi, dTheta, and dPsi.

Field.name: sampleInterval
Field.comment: During spherical sampling, the minimum interval in ^degrees at which Theta and Psi will be sampled. This sampling interval ^will be used at the equator, with larger intervals nearer the poles.

Field.name: dPhi
Field.comment: Angular search range around the particle Y axis.

Field.name: dTheta
Field.comment: Angular search range around the particle Z axis.

Field.name: dPsi
Field.comment: Angular search range around the paricle X axis.

autodoc.Field: = = = Search radii in tomogram pixels for each iteration. ^A single integer specifies the same radius for X, Y, and Z, while ^a vector of 3 integers gives X, Y, and Z radii separately. E.g. <^searchRadius>{4, 5} is equivalent to searchRadius={[4 4 4], [5 5 5]}.</^searchRadius>

= = = The frequency domain cutoff parameters for prefiltering the <^particles and reference. lowCutoff>< 0 prevents low frequency ^filtering. An optional second parameter defines the transition width.</^particles and reference. lowCutoff>

= = = The frequency domain cutoff parameters for prefiltering the <^particles and reference. hiCutoff >>0.866 prevents high frequency ^filtering. An optional second parameter defines the transition width.</^particles and reference. hiCutoff >>

Field.name: CCMode
Field.comment: The cross correlation measure to use. ^0: Local energy normalized cross correlation (default) ^1: True local correlation coefficient
Field.tooltip: The cross correlation measure to use.

Field.name: refThreshold
Field.comment: Controls reference generation at each iteration. If less ^than or equal 1, it specifies the minimum cross-correlation threshold. ^If greater than 1, it is the number of particles to use.

Field.name: refFlagAllTom
Field.comment: Controls particle selection during reference generation. ^1: use particles with the best correlation scores among all ^ particles of all tomos when creating new references. ^0: prefer equal numbers of particles from each tomogram ^ when creating new references.
Field.enum.1.tooltip: Use particles with the best correlation scores among all particles of all tomos when creating new references.
Field.enum.0.tooltip: Prefer equal numbers of particles from each tomogram when creating new references.

Field.name: tiltRange
Field.comment: The tilt angles used to acquire the tilt series [min max]. ^Used to compensate for the missing wedge during alignment and ^averaging. An empty array, [] or {}, disables this compensation ^(and uses more efficient but less accurate real-space averaging). ^For use with dual or multiple axes, tiltRange can also be a (cell) ^array of strings, with each string specifying the path to an ^appropriate binary mask.

Field.name: edgeShift
Field.comment: The number of pixels to shift the edge of the wedge mask to ^ensure that all of the frequency info is included.

Field.name: flgWedgeWeight
Field.comment: Apply missing wedge compensation during alignment?

Field.name: nWeightGroup
Field.comment: Number of groups to use for equalizing cross-correlation ^between groups with different orientations during averaging.

Field.name: lstThresholds
Field.comment: Numbers of particles to use for computing the final ^averages. ^A volume will generated for each value in this vector. The ^resulting files will be named <fnOutput>_AvgVol_<iterNum>P<navg>.mrc

Field.name: lstFlagAllTom
Field.comment: Controls particle selection during final averaging. ^1: use particles with best correlation scores among all particles ^ of all tomos when creating final averages. ^0: prefer equal number of particles from each tomo when creating ^ final averages.
Field.enum.1.tooltip: : Use particles with best correlation scores among all particles of all tomos when creating final averages.
Field.enum.0.tooltip: Prefer equal number of particles from each tomo when creating final averages.

autodoc.Field: = = = The basename for writing individual aligned particles. <^(default>'' or missing means do not create these files).</^(default>

Field.name: debugLevel
Field.comment: How much debugging info to print < 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 >

Field.name: flgAlignAverages
Field.comment: If non-zero, align particles to have their Y axes ^approximately vertical in the final averages.
Field.tooltip: Align averages to have the particle's Y axis approximately vertical.

Field.name: flgRemoveDuplicates
Field.comment: If non-zero, duplicate particles will be removed ^from further consideration after each round of alignment by assigning ^them to the duplicate class ID (-9999). AverageAll and related programs ^ignore members of this class when flgRemoveDuplicates is 1 unless -9999 ^is explicitly added to selectClassID.

Field.name: duplicateShiftTolerance
Field.comment: An integer array giving the maximum distances ^in pixels at which particles can be considered duplicates at each ^iteration. As for searchRadius, X, Y and Z distances may be specified ^individually or a single number can be given for all 3.
Field.tooltip: The maximum distance in pixels at which particles can be considered duplicates

Field.name: duplicateAngularTolerance
Field.comment: An array giving the maximum angle in degrees ^between orientations at which particles can be considered ^duplicates at each iteration.
Field.tooltip: The maximum orientation difference in degrees at which particles can be considered duplicates

Field.name: flgAbsValue
Field.comment: If 1 (default), maximize the absolute value of the ^cross-correlation during alignment rather than the raw ^cross-correlation. Use of the absolute value reduces the chance of ^pure noise reinforcing to match the reference, but can prevent ^proper alignment of some highly repetitive patterns (e.g. ^checkerboard or zebra stripe patterns) in which in which in- and ^out-of-phase alignments become indistinguishable.
Field.tooltip: Maximize absolute value of cross-correlation rather than cross-correlation.

Field.name: flgStrictSearchLimits
Field.comment: If 0 (default) or missing, radial and angular ^search limits will be applied independently at each iteration. If 1, ^the overall change for any parameter will be limited to the largest ^change specified at any single iteration.

Field.name: yaxisObjectNum
Field.comment: OBSOLETE. No longer supported.

Field.name: yaxisContourNum
Field.comment: OBSOLETE. No longer supported.

Field.name: relativeOrient
Field.comment: OBSOLETE. No longer supported.

Field.name: meanFill
Field.comment: OBSOLETE. No longer supported.

Field.name: cylinderHeight
Field.comment: The height in voxels of the cylindrical mask. Blank or ^NaN will be treated as infinite.

Field.name: flgRandomize
Field.comment: = If 1 (default = 0), select particles for averaging ^randomly rather than by cross-correlation.

Field.name: maskBlurStdDev
Field.comment: Blur the mask by convolution with a Gaussian having ^this standard deviation (in voxels). If omitted or NaN (the default), ^the mask will be binary. After blurring, the mask edge will be spread ^over approximately 2.5 standard deviations on either side of the ^original edge location.

Field.name: flgVolNamesAreTemplates
Field.comment: = If 1 (default = 0), file names in the volume ^table (i.e. volume, model, initial motive list, and wedge mask file ^names) may be templates to be expanded rather than individual ^filenames. For example, "vol1-10.mrc", would be expanded by PEET to ^[vol1.mrc, vol2.mrc, ... vol10.mrc]. Any filename ending in 2 numbers ^separated by a dash ('-') and, optionally, follwed by a suffix, will ^be considered a template.

Field.name: excludeList
Field.comment: A list of particle numbers to be excluded.
Field.tooltip: A list of particle numbers to be excluded

Field.name: includeList
Field.comment: A list of particle numbers to be included.
Field.tooltip: A list of particle numbers to be included

Field.name: selectClassID
Field.comment: A list of class numbers to be included.
Field.tooltip: A list of class numbers to be included

Field.name: flgElevationCompensation
Field.comment: = If 1 (default = 0), adjust correlation scores for variation ^with elevation angle during particle selection.
Field.tooltip: = Adjust correlations scores for variation with elevation angle.

Field.name: flgFRM
Field.comment: If 1 (default) allow fast rotational matching when applicable.
Field.tooltip: Allow fast rotational matching.

Field.name: flgFilterRefOnly
Field.comment: = If 1 (default = 0), during alignment apply frequency filtration ^to the reference only, rather than both reference and particles.
Field.tooltip: = Frequency filter only the reference during alignment.

Field.name: flgFPWedgeMask
Field.comment: = If 1 (default = 0), allow floating point wedge masks.
Field.tooltip: = Allow floating point wedge masks.

Field.name: yAxisSymmetry
Field.comment: A per iterations list of axial symmetry search orders. ^Iterations with entries N > 1 will perform a rotation only search ^about tomogram Y for axial symmetry.
Field.tooltip: A per iteration list of axial symmetry search oders

Field.name: flgAllowMaskedCorrelation
Field.comment: = If 1 (default = 0) use a slower cross-correlation calculation ^which may be slightly more accurate when masking is in use.
Field.tooltip: = Use slower cross-correlation computation which may be more more accurate with masking.

Field.name: flgSearchAlongParticleAxes
Field.comment: = If 1 (default = 0), search distances will be (approximately) ^along particle rather than tomogram coordinates.
Field.tooltip: = Search along particle rather than tomogram coordinates.

Field.name: cNSymmetricAveraging
Field.comment: = If > 1 (default = 1), apply cN axial symmerization about ^tomogram Y during averaging and related operations.
Field.tooltip: = An integer N requesting cN axial symmetrization about tomogram Y during all averaging and related operations

Field.name: flgCNMasking
Field.comment: If 1 (default), apply a spherical real-space mask during ^symmetric averaging.
Field.tooltip: Apply a spherical real-space mask during cN symmetric averaging.

Field.name: flgUseExtractedParticles
Field.comment: Use previously extracted particles (rather than automatically ^extracting on the fly).
Field.tooltip: User previously extracted particles (rather than automatically extracting on the fly)

Field.name: userCommands
Field.comment: A cell array of optional user commands to be executed ^after corresponding iterations.
Field.tooltip: Optional user commands to be run after corresponding iterations
